server.description: Server address: host or host:port for TCP (port 7835 when omitted), or ws://host/path or wss://host/path

name.description: This visitor's name, as defined under visitors in the server config

secret.description: 256-bit secret (base64 or hex) shared with the server

forwards.description: Local ports that lead to private services or client targets, keyed by forward name

headers.description: Extra HTTP headers for the WebSocket upgrade, for example an access token for a proxy

ca.description: CA certificate, or the server certificate itself (pinned), to trust for wss://; relative to the config file

proxy.description: Connect through a proxy: http://host:port or socks5://[user:pass@]host:port

udp.description: UDP forwards: how long a local UDP peer is kept without traffic, and how many peers each forward port keeps

service.description: Private service on the server to reach

client.description: Client to reach directly, with target; needs reach for this visitor in the server config

target.description: host:port as seen from the client, or a port alone for 127.0.0.1 on the client

socks.description: With client: listen as a SOCKS5 proxy, so each connection names its own target on that client

protocol.description: tcp or udp; must match the service's protocol on the server, and reach covers both

local.description: Where to listen on this machine: a port alone for 127.0.0.1, or ip:port

session_timeout_secs.description: A local UDP peer of a UDP forward that sends and gets nothing for this long is forgotten

max_peers.description: Most UDP peers each port of a UDP forward keeps at once; a datagram from a new peer beyond it is dropped
